senses.gloss:
Komaṭi
or pedakomaTi Reddi king of Koṇḍavīḍu. in Āndhra; son of Māca an. father of Vemabhūpāla (a. of C. Śṛṅgāradīpikā on Amaruśataka etc. an. patron of Vāmana Bhaṭṭa Bāṇa. IO. 4007. MD. 11927).

Komaṭiyajvan
of Vatsagotra; son of Varadāgnicit an. father of Vāmana Bhaṭṭa Bāṇa (a. of Vemabhūpālacarita, Śabdaratnākara etc.).
See TCD. 1592.

Komalakośasaṅgraha
compiled from several lexicons. by Tīrthasvāmin. L. 1059.

Komalaṭīkā
ny. vaiś. by Viśvanātha. BORI. 132 of 1871-72. Gough p. 90 (inc.). Gu. 6.

Komalavallīprapatti
on Komalavallī, a form of goddess Lakṣmī, worshipped a. Kumbhakonam. by Veṅkaṭeśa, son of Prativādibhayaṅkara of Śrīvatsagotra. MT. 1453 (z).

Komalavallīmaṅgalāśāsana
stotra. apparently by Veṅkaṭeśa, MT. 1453 (a-1).
See previous.

Komalavallīstava
by Maheśvarānanda. Q. in his Mahārthamañjarī TSS. 66. p.. 53, 75, 89 (mayApyuktaM komalavallIstave).

Komalavallīstava
ms. in a private collection in Nagappattanam noticed in Adyar Library Bulletin VI. p. 205.

Komalā
name of C. by Viśvanāthatīrtha (latter half of 16th Cent. A. D.) on Śaśadhara's Nyāyasiddhāntadīpa. [Page095-a.
See History of Navyanyāya in Mithilā p. 185.

Komalādaṇḍaka
stotra on goddess Komalavallī a. Kumbhakonam. by Veṅkaṭeśa or Veṅkaṭārya (Pāttrārya), son of Kumāra Tātadeśika. MD. 9710.
Pt.. Deśikasampradāyavivardhinīsabhā work no. 17. in Grantha script. Kumbhakonam, 1911. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1360.
